text:
Marta: quick sanity check — onboarding new quantized variant and seeing tiny divergence after ~8k tokens, maybe rope index wrap? anyone else seen this with long-window runs? :thinking:
Sam: I can run a long-run on dev cluster, which model/quant config is this?
Marta: model=new-onboard-13b-q4v3, runtime=dedicated-dev, cache_mode=ropecache, token_limit=16384. repro script below.
Marta: ```bash
# reproduce locally (dev rig)
python tools/generate_long.py --model new-onboard-13b-q4v3 \n  --cache-mode ropecache --seq-len 16384 --prompt-file tests/longseed.txt \n  --save-kv trace.json
```
Lee: thanks. what does "divergence" look like? token mismatch or logprob shift?
Marta: not an immediate token mismatch — softmax distribution shifts gradually. but at ~8192 boundary we see a sudden jump in top-k ordering for a few steps, then it recovers. logs: 
Marta: ```
[INFO] step=8188 top1="and" p=0.214
[INFO] step=8192 top1="the" p=0.178  <-- unexpected flip
[INFO] step=8195 top1="and" p=0.203
```
Raj: sounds like a RoPE index aliasing/stride issue rather than quant per-token rounding. Could be an index overflow when we convert absolute positions into rotary phases for cached shards.
Sam: I ran one replicate on dev (dedicated-dev/gpu-a100-40G) — see quick output: 
ci-bot: test/long-window/ropecache_integration — FAILURE (drift_threshold_exceeded)
eval-bot: regression-check: delta_logprob=0.042, top1-flip-count=3 (threshold=2)
Sam: attaching trace diffs (short): 
Sam: ```
-- trace.diff --
kv_shard_2: index_offset 8192 vs 0
rot_phase_12: value drift 1.2e-3 at pos=8192
```
Lee: can you try setting rope_scale=1/2 or enabling explicit pos_mod? I've seen rotational aliasing when we shard KV by 8k windows.
Marta: good idea. I'll try two experiments: (A) set rope_scale=0.5, (B) restart index counter on seamless shard boundaries.
Raj: also worth comparing q4v3 vs fp16 for the same run but with identical KV layout. if fp16 doesn't drift, quant conversion might be slightly shifting rotor matrices.
Marta: plan:
- run fp16 baseline (n=2)
- run q4v3 baseline (n=3)
- run q4v3 + rope_scale=0.5 (n=2)
- instrument KV index deltas and dump rot_matrices at boundary
Marta: schedule: can someone run fp16 baseline now? Sam?
Sam: starting fp16 baseline on dev now, tagging the job: rope-int-fp16-4932. ETA ~25m.
Lee: I'll add an integration probe to dump per-layer rotary phase for steps 8180-8200. small patch coming in a sec.
Marta: thanks — pushing a small flag to the runner: --dump-rotary 8180-8200 --kv-debug.
ci-bot: job rope-int-fp16-4932 queued -> running on dedicated-dev-03
Sam: quick note: if this is an index offset bug it's likely deterministic and should repro on single-card. we should avoid distributed sharding for the bisect.
Marta: agreed. will force single-shard run for bisect.
Raj: after we confirm, add a microtest in model-adapter that validates pos->rot mapping across wrappoints (unit test for pos%window==0 case).
Marta: cool. I'll open a PR with the microtest once we have a reproducible dump.
Sam: fp16 baseline finished: no top1 flips in the same seed run (delta_logprob=0.006). uploading artifacts to s3://redwood-dev/rope-int/4932105555/fp16
Marta: thanks. that points at quant flow. starting q4v3 replicate now.
Marta: q4v3 replicate 1 shows the same flip at 8192. attaching trace: s3://redwood-dev/rope-int/4932105555/q4v3/rep1/trace.json
Lee: patch for rotary dump pushed: https://git.redwood.internal/r/eng-ml/rotary-debug/+/2
Lee: try run with env ROPE_SAFE_WRAP=1 to enable an alternate mod path. it's cheap to toggle.
Marta: launching q4v3 + ROPE_SAFE_WRAP=1 now.
Marta: also noted: the flip coincides with a KV-shard swap log line: "kv: shard_rotate seq=8192 -> shard=3". maybe the rotation isn't applying an offset correction to the pos index used by rotary kernel.
Sam: got it. if that's the case the fix is small (pos_offset += shard_base) but need tests.
Raj: next steps after repro: bisect quant table transform (scale/zero-point) differences, and run cross-check with golden rot_matrices from fp16 run.
Marta: tagging @Lee and @Raj for follow-ups. I'll drop a short summary in the model-adoption ticket once we have the q4v3 dumps. :memo:
Lee: noted. will start adding unit tests and a quick reproducer harness.
Marta: thanks all — will post updates here as runs finish. :eyes:
